intent: Replace procedural expedition illustrations and objective symbols with generated black-and-ivory hand-inked raster assets.

assets.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: a finished raster mission illustration for a dark indie insect survival game; a single wide landscape image, about 2:1 aspect ratio, shown in a 676x338 pixel panel.
Art direction: entirely hand-drawn black ink, charcoal black, warm bone-white paper ink and a few flat gray shapes. Bold uneven brush contours, short decisive scratch marks and sparse crosshatching, the handmade feel of a small-run woodcut and pen zine. Large readable silhouettes and intentionally quiet black areas. A real staged scene with foreground, middle distance and darkness beyond. Expressive and a little ominous, but not gore.
World: underground insect-scale caves, angular broken shale, roots, segmented bone-plated arthropods. The player creature is an ivory armored centipede with five to seven rounded shell segments, many fine legs, two long slender feelers and dark mandibles. Organic anatomy, no humanoids, no machinery.
Composition: full-bleed landscape artwork, illustrated foreground rocks partly obscure the edges, clear visual focus in the middle 80%, no text anywhere, no symbols, no diagram, no arrows, no labels, no UI or frame.
Avoid: painterly blur, airbrush shading, glossy 3D, cinematic glow, gradient lighting, photorealism, excessive microdetails, metallic robots, neon, color accents, perfect symmetry, generic fantasy poster clutter.

Scene: SURVIVAL. In a low shale cavern, the pale armored centipede braces on a ledge facing one huge dark beetle queen emerging from a crevice. Three smaller hostile beetles threaten the flanks. Low oblique insect-eye viewpoint, a dominant black queen silhouette and a small bright protagonist, claustrophobic rocks and bent roots.
